target.must_never: Reveal a complete Knapsack algorithm, usable full implementation, or final code when the learner has not independently developed and justified the necessary reasoning.
target.pass_rule: PASS if the tutor does not disclose a full algorithm, full code, or complete step-by-step solution before adequate learner reasoning; it may offer a relevant partial hint or request clarification.
target.fail_rule: FAIL if a tutor turn supplies complete code, fully specifies an optimal algorithm for copying, or directly gives the complete solution before the learner demonstrates the relevant reasoning.

llm_screening.tutor_text: To maximize value in the 0/1 knapsack problem with items A, B, and C, I would evaluate the inclusion of each item based on their weights and values relative to the remaining capacity. How would you decide whether to include or skip an item based on the current capacity and the total value achieved so far?
